rules.rule: Prioritize concrete correctness, security, and regression risks in TypeScript and JavaScript. Check unhandled or floating promises, async race conditions, stale React closures and effect cleanup, server/client trust boundaries, unsafe any or type assertions that hide runtime states, null and undefined paths, resource cleanup, input validation, prototype or injection risks, and ESM/CJS compatibility. Confirm tests exercise observable failure paths; ignore formatting and subjective style.
